rules.query: (up{job="q4t"} == 1) unless on (job, instance) (count by (job, instance) ({__name__=~"q4t_active_chats|q4t_business_connections|q4t_control_connections|q4t_execution_steps_total|q4t_generation_tokens_total|q4t_gpu_healthy|q4t_http_receive_failures_total|q4t_http_write_failures_total|q4t_memory_admission_enabled|q4t_memory_admission_floor_bytes|q4t_memory_admission_open|q4t_memory_admission_recovery_bytes|q4t_memory_admission_state|q4t_memory_admission_transitions_total|q4t_memory_available_bytes|q4t_memory_observation_failures_total|q4t_memory_observation_valid|q4t_memory_observations_total|q4t_memory_rejected_total|q4t_prompt_tokens_total|q4t_queue_rejected_total|q4t_queued_requests|q4t_ready|q4t_request_body_bytes|q4t_requests_aborted_by_reason_total|q4t_requests_aborted_total|q4t_requests_error_total|q4t_requests_success_total|q4t_requests_total|q4t_seq_slots_free|q4t_seq_slots_total|q4t_structured_active|q4t_structured_compile_timeouts_total|q4t_structured_prepare_failed_total|q4t_structured_preparing|q4t_structured_rejected_total|q4t_structured_resource_exhausted_total|q4t_structured_vocab_bytes|q4t_structured_workers_active|q4t_structured_workers_reaped_total|q4t_structured_workers_started_total|q4t_text_admission_rejected_total",job="q4t"}) == 87)

annotations.summary: The operational metric contract is incomplete.

rules.name: Q4TMetricContractInvalid
rules.query: max by (job, instance) (({__name__=~"q4t_gpu_healthy|q4t_memory_admission_enabled|q4t_memory_admission_open|q4t_memory_admission_state|q4t_memory_observation_valid|q4t_ready",job="q4t"} != 0 and on (__name__, job, instance, state) {__name__=~"q4t_gpu_healthy|q4t_memory_admission_enabled|q4t_memory_admission_open|q4t_memory_admission_state|q4t_memory_observation_valid|q4t_ready",job="q4t"} != 1) or (sum by (job, instance) (q4t_memory_admission_state{job="q4t"}) != 1) or (q4t_seq_slots_free{job="q4t"} > on (job, instance) q4t_seq_slots_total{job="q4t"})) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Operational observations are contradictory or invalid.

rules.name: Q4TGpuUnhealthy
rules.query: max by (job, instance) (q4t_gpu_healthy{job="q4t"} == 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: The server has observed a sticky GPU failure.

rules.name: Q4TMemoryObservationUnavailable
rules.query: max by (job, instance) (q4t_memory_admission_enabled{job="q4t"} == 1 and q4t_memory_observation_valid{job="q4t"} == 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Memory observation is unavailable and new work is refused.

rules.name: Q4TMemoryPressure
rules.query: max by (job, instance) (q4t_memory_admission_state{job="q4t",state="memory_pressure"} == 1) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: The memory gate is closed to new work.

rules.name: Q4TMemoryGateDisabled
rules.query: max by (job, instance) (q4t_memory_admission_enabled{job="q4t"} == 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Global memory admission is explicitly disabled; verify deployment intent.

rules.name: Q4TNotReady
rules.query: max by (job, instance) (q4t_ready{job="q4t"} == 0 and q4t_gpu_healthy{job="q4t"} == 1 and q4t_memory_admission_open{job="q4t"} == 1) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: The server remains unready outside the GPU and memory gates.

rules.name: Q4TAdmissionRejections
rules.query: max by (job, instance) (increase(q4t_queue_rejected_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) > 0 or increase(q4t_text_admission_rejected_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) > 0 or increase(q4t_structured_rejected_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) > 0 or (increase(q4t_memory_rejected_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) > 0) or (increase(q4t_http_receive_failures_total{job="q4t",reason="body_capacity"}[5m]) > 0)) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Admission rejections increased; counters are separate views, not an additive failure total.

rules.name: Q4TStructuredFailures
rules.query: max by (job, instance) (increase(q4t_structured_prepare_failed_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) > 0 or increase(q4t_structured_compile_timeouts_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) > 0 or increase(q4t_structured_resource_exhausted_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) > 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Structured preparation failures increased; inspect fixed error codes.

rules.name: Q4TChatErrorsObserved
rules.query: max by (job, instance) (increase(q4t_requests_error_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) > 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Chat errors increased; this includes input rejection and is not a model error rate.

rules.name: Q4TTransportWriteFailures
rules.query: max by (job, instance) (increase(q4t_http_write_failures_total{job="q4t",reason=~"write_deadline|socket_error|exception"}[5m]) > 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Unexpected write failures increased; delivery and task outcome differ.

rules.name: Q4TTransportReceiveFailures
rules.query: max by (job, instance) (increase(q4t_http_receive_failures_total{job="q4t",reason=~"header_deadline|body_deadline|socket_error|exception"}[5m]) > 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Receive deadlines or transport faults increased.

rules.name: Q4TWorkerReapStalled
rules.query: max by (job, instance) (q4t_structured_workers_active{job="q4t"} > 0 and q4t_structured_active{job="q4t"} == 0 and q4t_structured_preparing{job="q4t"} == 0 and (q4t_active_chats{job="q4t"} == 0 and q4t_business_connections{job="q4t"} == 0)) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: A worker remains owned after requests and structured leases have drained.

rules.name: Q4TIdleResourcesRetained
rules.query: max by (job, instance) ((q4t_request_body_bytes{job="q4t"} > 0 or q4t_structured_active{job="q4t"} > 0 or (q4t_seq_slots_free{job="q4t"} < on (job, instance) q4t_seq_slots_total{job="q4t"})) and (q4t_active_chats{job="q4t"} == 0 and q4t_business_connections{job="q4t"} == 0)) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Resources remain retained while observed business work is idle.

rules.name: Q4TExecutionProgressStalled
rules.query: max by (job, instance) ((q4t_active_chats{job="q4t"} > 0) and (q4t_seq_slots_free{job="q4t"} < on (job, instance) q4t_seq_slots_total{job="q4t"}) and (changes(q4t_execution_steps_total{job="q4t"}[5m]) == 0)) and on (job, instance) (up{job="q4t"} == 1)

annotations.summary: No execution boundary progress was observed; investigate before acting.

rules.name: q4t:local_response_p95_seconds:5m
rules.query: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, instance, le) (rate(q4t_response_seconds_bucket{job="q4t"}[5m])))

rules.name: q4t:slot_wait_p95_seconds:5m
rules.query: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, instance, le) (rate(q4t_slot_wait_seconds_bucket{job="q4t"}[5m])))
